dimensions.note: No credentials are read or stored. Every model call uses the host's claude CLI login; no API key field exists. Nothing secret is logged or written to data.
Every method logs entry and completion with structured placeholders; failed claude requests log a warning with key and error. Prompts and document text are never logged.

All validation and claude-result checks throw before writeResource; each resource write is parsed through its Zod spec. Errors name the file, batch or finding. try/catch is limited to realPath/stat probes and spawning claude, whose failure is recorded per request as ok=false. hashSourceFiles skips reviewer-supplied paths that resolve outside repoRoot or are not files, and records missing files as absent instead of throwing; a previous report without inputs is treated as a baseline rather than an error.

26 Deno tests across sibling *_test.ts files: success and failure paths for every method; cli_generate_many_tools against a stub claude on PATH that emits stream-json, asserting the toolUse resource is written for tool-enabled requests only; stream-json parsing (last result event, Read/Grep/Glob extraction, dedup, cwd-relative paths, a session killed mid-stream keeps its reads and is ok=false); legacy single-object JSON still parses. Drift: first-run and legacy baselines, unchanged-input rises suppressed, below-threshold rises, changed-input rises flagged, errored docs carried forward, new docs as baselines, hashSourceFiles confinement, doc-link resolution, and a change to a file the session Read but did not self-report flagged as new drift. Live (Haiku): egm-review stages 5+9 succeeded on the stream-json parser (5/5 reviewers, 27 findings, all traced, toolUse written); drift baseline 6 passed, unchanged 6->7 suppressed and passed, matching doc 0->0, then 0->3 after removing code failed at assert-no-new-drift (twice, before and after the stream-json change); recorded filesRead matched the files opened.

Each run gets a fresh batch id, so stale cliResult data from earlier runs is never mixed in; merge refuses findings from another batch. applyFixes backs up first, writes via temp file + rename, and refuses if the document hash changed, so a re-run cannot double-apply. Drift: a document whose analysis errors keeps its last good count and inputs, so a transient failure does not reset it to a baseline. The drift behavior ships a no-op upgrade to 2026.11.17.2 (globalArguments unchanged).

No HTTP API besides optional fetch of operator-approved URLs (checks res.ok, 20s timeout). claude CLI JSON output is parsed defensively and every model answer is validated with Zod before use. claude is now run with --output-format stream-json --verbose; the outcome comes from the last result event (same fields as json output), truncated lines are skipped, and a bare json object is still accepted.

Tool-less sessions run in a temp dir removed in finally (covered by a test); every claude subprocess is bound to an AbortSignal timeout plus the method signal. Source hashing is capped at 500 files per document, and files over 20 MiB are fingerprinted by size and mtime instead of read. stream-json output includes tool results, so per-session stdout is larger; it is bounded by one session and parsed line by line.
README, skill and tests use /path/to/repo, docs/design.md and temp dirs. Denylist sweep (45 patterns, comments stripped) and a local path/host sweep over the 2026.11.17.2 diff returned 0 hits.

Resource schemas are plain z.object. The only .passthrough() schemas parse model answers (egm_lib FindingSchema/ReviewerOutputSchema) so extra fields a reviewer adds are kept under rawFindings.extra; they are never resource schemas.

Every spec sets lifetime infinite with garbageCollection 10 (drift report 30, to keep the run-over-run baseline). cliResult retention is @keeb/anthropic's (30d). The extension-declared toolUse spec on @keeb/anthropic/claude is lifetime infinite with garbageCollection 10.
Pipeline behaviors (prepare/collect/report), not CRUD lifecycle resources.

applyFixes edits a user document but declares no swamp pre-flight checks; its guards are inline (approval gate in the workflow, document-hash match, unique/in-range/non-overlapping edits, backup first). Follow-up: expose the hash and applicability checks as labelled checks.

One instance per spec, named after the spec (reviewPlan, findings, reports, plan, report, resolveRequest, resolution, applyResult); collectFindings writes the same schema on both passes. cliResult instances are cli-<batch>-<key> with unique keys enforced.

Own state via readResource; other behaviors' results via readModelData filtered by batch. No direct dataRepository access, no shelling out to swamp. Drift reads toolUse records from the results instance filtered by spec and batch; review and resolve read only cliResult, so the extra records do not affect them.

@sntxrr/egm/drift moves to 2026.11.17.2 with a no-op upgrade entry; its globalArguments (repoRoot, docsDir) are unchanged. The new writeReport input has a default, and a previous report written by 2026.11.17.1 (no inputs field) is read as a baseline. @sntxrr/egm and @sntxrr/egm/resolve are unchanged at 2026.11.17.1.
